artworks.title: Portrait de l'artiste, dit Courbet au chien noir
Soleil couchant sur la Seine à Lavacourt, effet d'hiver
Trois baigneuses
artworks.visual: Three nude women bathing under arching trees, built up with thick parallel diagonal brushstrokes, dominated by greens and blues.
notes: Bought by Henri Matisse in 1899 when he was still poor and unknown; he kept it for 37 years.
When Matisse donated it to the Petit Palais in 1936, he wrote that the painting had sustained him morally at critical moments of his life as an artist.
